Money Guides

View all Money guides →

Plain-English money guides — GST, EMI, credit scores, inflation, compound interest, credit cards and savings accounts.

What is GST?

GST (Goods and Services Tax) is a single tax charged on the sale of most goods and services in India. It replaced a long list of separate central and state taxes with one system.

What is EMI?

EMI (Equated Monthly Instalment) is the scheduled amount you pay toward a loan each month, made up of principal and interest. Fixed-rate loans generally keep the EMI fixed, while floating-rate loans may change the EMI or tenure.

What is a Credit Score?

A credit score is a number calculated from your credit history, including repayment behaviour, outstanding debt and credit enquiries. In India, CIBIL commonly uses a 300–900 range, but each credit information company (CIC) calculates its own score and lender decisions also consider income, affordability and other information.

What is Inflation?

Inflation is the general rise in prices of goods and services over time, which means each rupee buys a little less than it used to.

What is Compound Interest?

Compound interest is interest calculated not just on your original amount, but also on the interest that has already been added to it — so your money grows faster over time compared to simple interest.

What is a Credit Card?

A credit card lets you borrow money from a bank up to a set limit to make purchases now, which you then repay by a due date — either in full, avoiding interest, or partially, which triggers interest charges.

What is a Savings Account?

A savings account is a basic bank account designed for individuals to safely deposit money, earn a modest interest on the balance, and access funds relatively easily through withdrawals, transfers and cards.

Documents Guides

View all Documents guides →

Plain-English guides for the documents Indian life runs on — Aadhaar, PAN, voter ID, passport, driving licence and state certificates.

What is a PAN Card?

A PAN (Permanent Account Number) card is a 10-character alphanumeric identity document issued by the Income Tax Department of India, mainly used to track financial transactions and file income tax returns.

What is UAN?

UAN (Universal Account Number) is a 12-digit identifier used to connect an eligible employee's EPF records across jobs. A UAN is different from the employer-specific Member IDs and PF records linked to it. EPFO and UMANG procedures can change, so verify the current instructions on the official services.

Aadhaar Card Update & Download — Complete Guide

Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identity number issued by UIDAI to every resident of India. It serves as proof of identity and address, and is required for most government schemes, bank accounts, PAN linkage, and mobile connections.

Ration Card — Apply, List & e-KYC Guide

Ration card ek official document hai jo eligible families ko subsidized food grains (chawal, gehu, sugar) government ke Public Distribution System (PDS) ke through provide karta hai. Yeh proof of identity aur proof of address bhi maana jaata hai.

E-Shram Card — Registration & Benefits

E-Shram Card unorganised sector ke workers ke liye ek national database registration card hai. E-Shram portal par register karne wale workers ko government schemes ka direct benefit, accident insurance cover, aur future social security benefits mil sakte hain.

Voter ID Card — Apply, Download & Correction Guide

Voter ID Card (EPIC — Electors Photo Identity Card) Election Commission of India dwara issue kiya jaata hai. Yeh proof of identity aur voting rights dono ka kaam karta hai. 18 saal ya usse zyada age ka koi bhi Indian citizen apply kar sakta hai.

Passport Apply Online — Complete Guide

Indian passport Ministry of External Affairs dwara issue kiya jaata hai. Passport Seva portal (passportindia.gov.in) par online apply karke aap ordinary, tatkaal, ya fresh passport ke liye apply kar sakte hain. Valid international travel document hai.

Driving Licence Apply & Renew — Guide

Driving Licence (DL) Motor Vehicles Department dwara issue kiya jaata hai aur yeh proof hai ki aap legally vehicle chala sakte hain. Parivahan portal (parivahan.gov.in) se online apply kar sakte hain — pehle Learner's Licence phir Permanent DL.

Birth Certificate — Apply & Download Guide

Birth Certificate ek official document hai jo child ke birth ki date, place aur parents ki details record karta hai. Yeh lifetime identity document hai aur school admission, Aadhaar, passport, property rights — sabke liye zaroori hai.

Income Certificate — Apply Online Guide

Income Certificate state government dwara issue kiya jaata hai aur yeh prove karta hai ki ek family ki annual income kitni hai. Scholarship, ration card, education admission, aur kai government schemes ke liye yeh zaroori document hai.

Caste Certificate — Apply Online Guide

Caste Certificate state government dwara issue kiya jaata hai aur yeh prove karta hai ki aap kaunsi caste category (SC/ST/OBC) se belong karte hain. Education admission, government jobs, aur reservation benefits ke liye yeh zaroori document hai.

Marriage Certificate — Registration Guide

Marriage Certificate ek legal document hai jo do logon ki marriage ko government ke saath register karta hai. Yeh proof of marriage hai aur passport, visa, bank joint accounts, property, aur legal rights ke liye zaroori hai.

Education Guides

View all Education guides →

Plain-English education guides — CGPA, scholarships, entrance exams and career options after 12th.

What is CGPA?

CGPA (Cumulative Grade Point Average) is a way of summarising a student's overall academic performance as a single average grade point across all subjects and terms, instead of using percentage marks.

Government Scholarships — Complete Guide

Government scholarships in India provide financial help to eligible students from school to postgraduate level. The National Scholarships Portal (NSP) at scholarships.gov.in is the official central gateway where students can apply for many central and state schemes and track their status.

Entrance Exams After 12th — Complete Guide

After Class 12, admission to many professional and university courses is decided through entrance exams. NTA (nta.ac.in) conducts major national exams like JEE Main, NEET UG and CUET UG, while CLAT is run separately by the law universities' consortium. Each exam has its own eligibility, syllabus and application window.

Career Options After 12th — Complete Guide

Career options after Class 12 depend on the stream you studied, your interests and your goals. Science opens engineering, medicine, pure sciences and technology paths; Commerce leads to accountancy, finance, business and management; Arts opens law, design, media, social sciences and more. Vocational and skill-based courses are available across streams.

Plain-English guides for government schemes and services — PM Kisan, Aadhaar, ration card and e-Shram, with official sources.

PM Kisan Yojana 2026

PM Kisan Samman Nidhi is a central government scheme that provides ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments to eligible farmer families across India. The amount is transferred directly to beneficiaries' bank accounts.

Aadhaar Card Update & Download — Complete Guide

Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identity number issued by UIDAI to every resident of India. It serves as proof of identity and address, and is required for most government schemes, bank accounts, PAN linkage, and mobile connections.

Ration Card — Apply, List & e-KYC Guide

Ration card ek official document hai jo eligible families ko subsidized food grains (chawal, gehu, sugar) government ke Public Distribution System (PDS) ke through provide karta hai. Yeh proof of identity aur proof of address bhi maana jaata hai.

Business Guides

View all Business guides →

Plain-English business guides — Udyam registration, FSSAI licence, MSME schemes, business loans, trademarks and GST.

Udyam Registration — Full Form, Apply Online & Benefits (2026 Guide)

Udyam Registration is the government process for recognising a micro, small or medium enterprise. It is free online and can help eligible businesses access MSME schemes, subsidies and lending benefits.

Udyam Registration for MSMEs

Udyam Registration is a free, online government registration for micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) in India. It replaces the older Udyog Aadhaar system and provides a unique Udyam Registration Number (URN) to eligible businesses.

FSSAI License — Apply & Renew Guide

FSSAI registration or license is mandatory for almost anyone who makes, stores, transports, distributes or sells food in India. It is applied for online on the official FoSCoS portal, and the license type depends on the annual turnover and scale of the food business.

MSME Schemes & Subsidies — Complete Guide

MSME schemes can support eligible enterprises through credit guarantees, finance, training, market access and other assistance. Every scheme has separate rules and application channels.

Business Loan — Apply & Eligibility Guide

A business loan provides funding for working capital, equipment, expansion or other business needs. Eligibility, interest and repayment depend on the lender, product and borrower profile.

Trademark Registration — Apply Guide

A trademark identifies and protects a brand feature such as a name, logo, word or symbol. Registration is applied for through the official IP India system after checking the mark and class.
